text:
maria: Quick heads-up — nightly canary for shortburst inference (us-west2) started failing during resource allocate with QuotaExceeded on instance create. Noticed ~22:02 UTC.

alex: Seen it. Which pool is it trying to carve from? standby or ephemeral-demo?

maria: It's the shortburst-iso pool (reserved for canaries). Terraform shows requested: 4 x a100-40gb, preemptible=false. Getting 403 error from GCP.

sanjay: Can you paste the error snippet?

maria: ```
Error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS_K80' exceeded for project 12345 in region us-west2.
operation: compute.instances.insert
```

alex: weird that it's K80 quota — our pool declares a100. Could be vendor returning a fallback SKU during allocation. Has anything changed in the cloud-allocator service?

riley: Not from our side. Procurement pinged vendor earlier about a rack firmware issue. procurement-bot posted an update at 20:30.

procurement-bot: Vendor update: shipment delayed. Estimated spare-shelf availability 48-72h. Will post if expedited option accepted.

vendor-op: Confirming — a subset of racks hit NIC firmware regression during burn. Logistics can reroute expedited but ETA ~36h with surcharge. No impact to existing reserved racks (those remain), but ephemeral slots may be remapped to older SKUs (hence K80 in the error).

lee: For tonight's canary we need a pass/fail smoke. Can we short-circuit by running a reduced config? e.g., seq_len=512, batch=4 on smaller GPUs (T4 or L4) just to validate end-to-end?

alex: Yes — we can toggle canary to use model-quantized-l4 variant and smaller seq_len. That will exercise routing, tracing, and cost telemetry without requiring A100.

maria: I'll patch the canary job. Plan: change pool from shortburst-iso -> shortburst-fallback, set model variant to v2-quant-l4, set seq_len=512, batch=4. Will open PR and deploy config.

maria: Draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/canaries/pull/1245 (WIP) — includes terraform change to use shortburst-fallback pool and a runtime flag CANARY_REDUCED=true.

alex: Nice. Can you add a quick note in the PR about telemetry keys to monitor (lat_p95, cost_per_token, kv_cache_hit)? We'll want a fast look tomorrow.

maria: Done. PR updated.

sanjay: If vendor can expedite to 36h and procurement approves surcharge, do we want to revert for full-run or keep fallback for an extra day to compare?

riley: I'd prefer revert once full capacity is back — we should avoid skewing CI with mixed SKUs. But keep a one-off A/B test planned for next week to measure cost/latency delta.

vendor-op: Noted. We'll update procurement thread with ETA confirmation when logistics confirms route.

lee: Oncall note: I'll coordinate smoke-run at 23:00 and report results to #incidents if anything fails. If the fallback pool also hits quota, we can run a purely local dry-run using smaller seq_len and no-live routing (dev sandbox).

maria: 23:00 smoke scheduled. I'll leave the roll to manual so we can abort quickly.

alex: One small ops tip — if allocation fails due to mismatched GPU SKU, allocator logs include attempted_sku and fallback_sku fields. Example query: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND jsonPayload.alloc_attempt" --limit 50`

maria: good call, will check logs after the first attempt.

procurement-bot: Noted. Procurement will confirm expedited option by EOD and update vendor ticket #VN-8892.

maria: Thanks all. Will post final status after the 23:00 smoke. If we get green we keep fallback overnight and revert in the morning if vendor confirms rack ETA <36h. :thumbsup:

vendor-op: Appreciated. Will escalate for 36h path and update procurement.

lee: :thumbsup:

maria: UPDATE 23:12 UTC — smoke run completed with reduced config: canary passed (lat_p95=120ms, cost ~0.45x baseline). No further action right now, leaving this thread open until vendor confirms.

sanjay: Great — please paste the short log snippet for trace.

maria: ```
23:11 canary-run: model=v2-quant-l4 seq=512 batch=4 p95=120ms tokens=12k status=PASS
23:11 allocator: pool=shortburst-fallback allocated_sku=L4 fallback=false
```

maria: Looping procurement and vendor. If anything changes I'll update here. Closing for now but will reopen if quota resurfaces. :heart:
